resource_order: DPLL fixed SRAM ARM may overlap TDMA record lease. After all STOP ACKs: TDMA save/readback and SAVED, then DPLL SAVE/readback.
tap_scope: Independent CS-relative diagnostic; header and sequence experiments grant neither DPLL eligibility nor timestamp/output precision.

binding.binding_limit: Board image is bound by selected P3/package/OTA evidence plus online UID/build. Build labels alone are not package fingerprints; no board flash hash query exists. Unflashed workspace edits are never treated as the board image.

receive_scope: Ordinary fixed mailbox DCO phase/rate/lock/quality from the configured master. Receive counts include bootstrap and autonomous transport; no DCO application or phase convergence claim follows from receive counts.
conclusion_scope: Observer-only recovery and same-epoch sequence growth. No DPLL feedback, actual follower DCO application or output precision is inferred. Sparse native records cannot establish per-frame losslessness.
